akun.title: Create a FLIXARE account
akun.desc: Choose the institution type, then fill in the person in charge. This account becomes your institution's first admin.

otp.title: Verify your contact
otp.desc: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to confirm this email belongs to you.

lembaga_school.title: School details
lembaga_school.desc: Enter the NPSN, then complete the school details. Each NPSN can use the trial only once.

lembaga_personal.title: Tutoring details
lembaga_personal.desc: This name appears on the student sign-in page and in reports to parents.

lembaga_event.title: Organizer details
lembaga_event.desc: This name appears on participant tickets and certificates.

paket_school.title: Choose plan & seats
paket_school.desc: Price per student per month, the same for SD, SMP, SMA and SMK. Seats set the limit of active students.

paket_personal.title: Choose a plan
paket_personal.desc: Change plans any time; the difference is prorated.

paket_event.title: Choose a session package
paket_event.desc: Unused sessions stay valid for 12 months after purchase.

bayar_trial.title: Confirm trial
bayar_trial.desc: No payment today. The first invoice is created automatically when the trial ends.

bayar_paid.title: Payment
bayar_paid.desc: Pay by Virtual Account or QRIS. Payments are verified automatically within seconds.

persetujuan_school.title: Awaiting approval
persetujuan_school.desc: The FLIXARE team is reviewing the school details. You may close this page; we will email you once approved.

persetujuan_personal.title: Approval
persetujuan_personal.desc: Your institution qualifies for automatic approval.

persetujuan_event.title: Approval
persetujuan_event.desc: Your institution qualifies for automatic approval.

provisioning.title: Preparing {institution}
provisioning.desc: A dedicated database for your institution is being created. This usually takes about 5 minutes.

profil_school.title: School & principal profile
profil_school.desc: This is used on report card headers and official letters.

profil_event.title: Organizer profile
profil_event.desc: Shown on participant tickets and certificates.

tahun.title: Academic year & semesters
tahun.desc: Semester dates drive schedules, attendance and report periods.

kelas_school.title: Grades & classes
kelas_school.desc: Set the number of classes per grade. Class names are generated automatically and can be changed later.

kelas_personal.title: Study groups
kelas_personal.desc: Create groups to organize your students.

mapel.title: Subjects & KKTP
mapel.desc: Subjects are suggested for the {level} level. Set the learning objective achievement criteria (KKTP) per subject.

guru.title: Teachers
guru.desc: Import from Excel using the FLIXARE template. Sign-in invitations are emailed to each teacher.

murid.title: Students
murid.desc: Import from Excel. The class column is matched to the classes you created.

selesai.title: {institution} is ready
selesai.desc: Initial setup is complete. You can fill in other data from the dashboard at any time.
